title: Listening Drill — Testing river pH — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Testing river pH — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on testing river pH last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with unclear colour. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: expired strip.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of sample volume so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow sample tubes instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the field tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
